text: {"532":{"about":["rustc_ast"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_ast defines compiler token kinds, including the end-of-file token."},"533":{"about":["rustc_ast","rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_ast defines token-tree structures while rustc_parse constructs grouped trees from balanced delimiters."},"534":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"rustc_expand performs macro expansion over token streams, whose representation is defined by rustc_ast."},"535":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"This describes the macro expander's syntax-oriented treatment of input rather than source-position details."},"536":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"The abstraction used by macro expansion is token-based, with token representations supplied by rustc_ast."}}
